data.command: What is T1078 Valid Accounts technique?

data.text:
T1078 Valid Accounts technique refers to the exploitation of existing, valid user accounts on a system. This can be done by using the credentials of a legitimate user to gain unauthorized access. In other words, an attacker uses an existing account, with the password, to gain access to a system. This tactic is a part of the Attacker Tactics Techniques and Procedures (TTP) framework, specifically within the "Valid Accounts" technique. This technique leverages the existing permissions and access rights of a valid user to perform malicious actions.

Now, to get back to our server, I'm currently running Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS, with kernel 5.15.0-91. The system is configured to use SSH (sshd) on port 22, and I've got a few users set up with different levels of access. For instance, the user "admin" has a home directory at /home/admin, and their default shell is set to bash.
